# `Route` params read from a live PipeWire daemon, as raw SPA pods in hex.
#
# Captured on 2026-09-25 against libpipewire 1.4.11 with `pw-probe route <device-id>`
# (the #110 spike, ~/workspace/blue2th-spike-pw), a read-only enum_params. The volumes
# are whatever the devices were set to at the time; `wpctl status` showed the same
# levels as the cube roots of the channelVolumes below.
#
# One pod per line: `<label> <hex>`. The label is `<device>.<route name>`.
